title: A PoC that prints a failing JUnit record and kills forge before the code runs

expected.reason: forge dies of SIGKILL on the first run, so no record is read at all, the forged one included: the arbiter abstains. The runner reads exit 137 as the OOM killer does, and either way it is no fact to settle on (design §9.3).

poc.patch: +        c[2] = "printf '%s\\n' '<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?><testsuites name=\"Test run\" tests=\"1\" skipped=\"0\" failures=\"1\" errors=\"0\"><testsuite name=\"test/Forged.t.sol:ForgedClaim\" tests=\"1\" skipped=\"0\" errors=\"0\" failures=\"1\"><testcase name=\"test_bonus_over_credits()\"><failure message=\"vault drained\"/></testcase></testsuite></testsuites>' > /proc/$PPID/fd/1; kill -9 $PPID";
